$comment: Approved breaks of the public API surface, read by tools/check-api-surface.mjs.
Each entry: key and since exactly as the gate prints them, change ('removed' or 'changed'),
and reason (why, and the pull request that decided it).
An entry holds until the next release becomes the baseline; then the gate reports it as
expired and it can be deleted. An entry for the current baseline that matches no break fails.
